主要内容: The Walt Disney Company issued $250,000,000 in 2.950% Notes Due 2027, fungible with previously issued Existing Notes. The New Notes were offered at 99.163% of par, with net proceeds of 98.893% of par after underwriting discounts. The issuance is part of a $750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 2.950% Notes Due 2027. The notes were issued under a Senior Debt Securities Indenture dated September 24, 2001, and registered under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended. The issuance was supported by an opinion from White & Case LLP, and the terms agreement was dated June 29, 2017.
